article.title: 香港Master Concept攜Supermetrics，把行銷數據接入Gemini Enterprise
article.title_en: Hong Kong’s Master Concept partners with Supermetrics on enterprise marketing data
article.summary: Master Concept於10月30日在香港公布與Supermetrics合作，協助企業把分散的行銷資料接入分析及AI環境，包括Gemini Enterprise。
article.summary_en: Master Concept announced an October 30 Hong Kong partnership with Supermetrics to connect fragmented marketing data with analytics and AI environments, including Gemini Enterprise.
article.why: 香港代理商可評估把報表整理與AI查詢接在同一資料基礎，先解決指標定義與資料權限。
article.why_en: Hong Kong agencies can assess reporting and AI queries on a shared data foundation, beginning with metric definitions and permissions.
article.next_step: 選一個唯讀跨平台報表，對照原始帳戶核實時區、貨幣、歸因及資料更新，再評估擴大接入。
article.next_step_en: Start with one read-only cross-platform report and reconcile time zones, currencies, attribution and freshness with source accounts before expanding access.
highlights: 公告列出GA4、廣告平台及其他行銷資料，可在Gemini Enterprise用自然語言探索活動表現與趨勢。
透過Master Concept提供30日Supermetrics試用；資格與開通安排需向團隊確認。
highlights_en: The announcement describes natural-language exploration of campaign performance using GA4, ad-platform and other marketing data in Gemini Enterprise.
A 30-day Supermetrics trial is offered through Master Concept, subject to eligibility and activation confirmation.
article.detail:
Master Concept於10月30日在香港公布與Supermetrics合作，協助企業把分散的行銷資料接入分析及AI環境，包括Gemini Enterprise。

公告列出GA4、廣告平台及其他行銷資料，可在Gemini Enterprise用自然語言探索活動表現與趨勢。

透過Master Concept提供30日Supermetrics試用；資格與開通安排需向團隊確認。

香港代理商可評估把報表整理與AI查詢接在同一資料基礎，先解決指標定義與資料權限。

選一個唯讀跨平台報表，對照原始帳戶核實時區、貨幣、歸因及資料更新，再評估擴大接入。

合作公告不等於所有帳戶即時接通，亦未證明報表時間或ROAS改善；寫入廣告活動的權限應另行評估。
article.detail_en:
Master Concept announced an October 30 Hong Kong partnership with Supermetrics to connect fragmented marketing data with analytics and AI environments, including Gemini Enterprise.

The announcement describes natural-language exploration of campaign performance using GA4, ad-platform and other marketing data in Gemini Enterprise.

A 30-day Supermetrics trial is offered through Master Concept, subject to eligibility and activation confirmation.

Hong Kong agencies can assess reporting and AI queries on a shared data foundation, beginning with metric definitions and permissions.

Start with one read-only cross-platform report and reconcile time zones, currencies, attribution and freshness with source accounts before expanding access.

The partnership does not establish immediate access for every account or measured reporting-time or ROAS gains. Campaign-write permissions require separate assessment.
